name: Snake Plant
description: A hardy, architectural plant perfect for interiors, office corners, and shaded verandas. Its upright leaves tolerate missed watering and bring strong structure to compact spaces.

name: Areca Palm
description: A graceful palm with feathery fronds that softens lobbies, patios, and indoor seating zones. It prefers bright indirect light and consistent moisture.

name: Tulsi
description: A sacred and medicinal herb widely used in Indian homes. Tulsi thrives in sunny courtyards, temple gardens, and kitchen planters with regular pruning.

name: Hibiscus
description: A dependable flowering shrub for tropical landscapes. Hibiscus creates colorful borders, living fences, and focal points when placed in full sun.

name: Jasmine
description: A beloved fragrant shrub for entrances, balconies, and garden edges. Jasmine rewards sunny placement with clusters of white blooms and evening scent.

name: Neem
description: A resilient native tree valued for shade, medicinal uses, and ecological benefits. Neem is best suited to open sunny sites with room to mature.

name: Bougainvillea
description: A sun-loving climber with bold color and excellent drought tolerance. It works beautifully over gates, compound walls, pergolas, and boundary trellises.

name: Aloe Vera
description: A compact succulent valued for its soothing gel and low water needs. Aloe Vera suits sunny window ledges, terrace planters, and dry landscape pockets.

name: Money Plant
description: A versatile trailing plant for shelves, partitions, and hanging baskets. Money Plant grows well in bright shade and can be trained up supports.

name: Marigold
description: A cheerful seasonal bloomer used in beds, borders, and temple or event landscaping. Marigold prefers sun and regular deadheading for fresh flowers.

name: Ixora
description: A compact evergreen shrub with dense flower clusters. Ixora is excellent for low hedges, driveway edges, and mixed ornamental planting schemes.

name: Peace Lily
description: An elegant indoor plant with glossy leaves and white spathes. Peace Lily suits reception counters, shaded interiors, and quiet hospitality spaces.

name: Rose
description: A classic flowering shrub for balconies, borders, and ceremonial gardens. Roses need bright sun, pruning, and rich soil for repeat blooms.

name: Chrysanthemum
description: A popular cool-season bloomer with dense colorful heads. It suits pots, borders, and festive flower displays with regular pinching.

name: Crossandra
description: A compact tropical plant known for orange fan-shaped blooms. Crossandra works well in warm garden edges and sunny containers.

name: Oleander
description: A tough flowering shrub for roadsides, boundaries, and dry sunny landscapes. It is ornamental only and should be kept away from children and pets.

name: Plumeria
description: A small flowering tree with fragrant blooms and sculptural branches. Plumeria is excellent near entrances, courtyards, and temple landscapes.

name: Canna Lily
description: A tropical plant with large leaves and vibrant flowers. Canna adds height and color to borders, water edges, and large planters.

name: Madagascar Periwinkle
description: A reliable flowering plant for hot sunny beds and containers. It produces cheerful blooms with minimal care in warm climates.

name: Gardenia
description: A fragrant shrub with creamy white flowers and glossy leaves. Gardenia prefers bright filtered light and slightly acidic soil.

name: Tuberose
description: A bulbous plant grown for tall spikes of intensely fragrant white flowers. Tuberose is ideal for sunny beds and flower production.

name: Lotus
description: A sacred aquatic plant with large floating leaves and showy flowers. Lotus needs full sun and a pond, tub, or water garden.

name: Champak
description: A fragrant flowering tree treasured in traditional gardens. Champak suits larger sunny spaces where its canopy and scent can be enjoyed.

name: Crape Jasmine
description: A glossy evergreen shrub with pinwheel-like white flowers. It works well for hedges, temple gardens, and courtyard planting.

name: Rangoon Creeper
description: A vigorous climber with flower clusters that change from white to pink and red. It is perfect for pergolas, arches, and compound walls.

name: Butterfly Pea
description: A fast-growing climber with vivid blue flowers. Butterfly Pea suits fences, balcony grills, and small trellises in sunny spots.

name: Allamanda
description: A tropical climber or shrub with large yellow trumpet flowers. Allamanda brightens gates, fences, and sunny garden corners.

name: Passion Flower
description: A vigorous climber with intricate flowers and edible fruit. It needs strong support, sun, and regular watering during establishment.

name: Flame Vine
description: A fast climber that covers walls with orange tubular flowers. Flame Vine is best trained over pergolas, arches, and sunny boundaries.

name: Garlic Vine
description: A decorative climber with purple trumpet flowers and garlic-scented leaves. It looks attractive on fences and sunny trellises.

name: Tecoma
description: A hardy shrub or small tree with bright yellow bell-shaped flowers. Tecoma is useful for sunny borders and roadside landscaping.

name: Pentas
description: A compact flowering plant with star-shaped clusters loved by butterflies. Pentas performs well in sunny beds and mixed planters.

name: Lantana
description: A rugged flowering shrub with multi-colored clusters. Use it carefully in managed beds, as it can spread aggressively in open landscapes.

name: Zinnia
description: A bright annual flower for sunny beds and pots. Zinnias grow quickly from seed and attract butterflies in warm weather.

name: Petunia
description: A colorful bedding plant for cool-season displays. Petunias suit hanging baskets, railing planters, and sunny garden beds.

name: Sunflower
description: A cheerful annual with large sun-facing flowers. Sunflower is excellent for open sunny patches, educational gardens, and seasonal displays.

name: Portulaca
description: A low-growing succulent annual with jewel-like flowers. Portulaca thrives in sunny, dry planters and rock garden pockets.

name: Cosmos
description: A light, airy annual with daisy-like flowers. Cosmos is perfect for informal sunny beds and pollinator-friendly seasonal gardens.

name: Celosia
description: A colorful annual with plume or cockscomb-shaped flowers. Celosia gives strong color to sunny pots, borders, and festival displays.

name: Geranium
description: A neat flowering plant for sunny balconies and pots. Geraniums prefer good drainage and regular trimming for compact growth.

name: Dahlia
description: A striking flowering plant grown from tubers. Dahlias create bold seasonal color in sunny beds and large containers.

name: Orchid
description: A graceful orchid suited to bright filtered light and airy potting media. It works beautifully in patios, balconies, and indoor display areas.

name: Anthurium
description: An indoor favorite with glossy leaves and bright heart-shaped spathes. Anthurium prefers bright indirect light, humidity, and airy soil.

name: ZZ Plant
description: A glossy, resilient indoor plant for offices and homes. ZZ Plant tolerates low light and missed watering better than many houseplants.

name: Spider Plant
description: A forgiving indoor plant that produces arching leaves and baby plantlets. It suits shelves, hanging baskets, and bright shaded corners.

name: Rubber Plant
description: A bold indoor plant with large glossy leaves. Rubber Plant works well as a statement piece in bright indirect light.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: A stylish indoor plant with large violin-shaped leaves. It prefers bright indirect light, stable watering, and a fixed location.

name: Monstera
description: A tropical foliage plant famous for split leaves. Monstera adds lush character to interiors and shaded patios with support.

name: Heartleaf Philodendron
description: A trailing indoor plant with heart-shaped leaves. It grows well on shelves, moss poles, and hanging baskets in bright shade.

name: Aglaonema
description: A compact foliage plant with patterned leaves. Aglaonema is ideal for desks, reception counters, and shaded indoor corners.

name: Dieffenbachia
description: A leafy indoor plant with attractive variegation. Grow it in bright shade and handle carefully, as its sap can irritate skin and mouth.

name: Syngonium
description: A versatile indoor plant with arrow-shaped leaves. Syngonium can trail, climb, or grow as a compact tabletop plant.

name: Boston Fern
description: A lush fern with arching fronds suited to shaded balconies and humid interiors. It needs regular moisture and filtered light.

name: Croton
description: A colorful foliage shrub with bold leaf patterns. Croton gives the best color in bright light and works well in borders and pots.

name: Coleus
description: A bright foliage plant grown for patterned leaves. Coleus is useful in shaded borders, mixed pots, and quick color schemes.

name: Calathea
description: A decorative indoor plant with patterned leaves. Calathea prefers bright shade, humidity, and evenly moist soil.

name: Jade Plant
description: A compact succulent with thick glossy leaves. Jade Plant suits sunny windows, tabletops, and dry container gardens.

name: Lucky Bamboo
description: A popular indoor plant often grown in water or pebbles. Lucky Bamboo suits desks, counters, and bright shaded interiors.

name: Song of India
description: A variegated foliage plant with upright branching growth. It is useful for indoor corners, shaded patios, and office planters.

name: Christmas Cactus
description: A tropical cactus with flat stems and bright seasonal flowers. It prefers bright indirect light rather than harsh sun.

name: Echeveria
description: A small rosette-form succulent for sunny windows and decorative bowls. Echeveria needs excellent drainage and light watering.

name: Agave
description: A bold succulent with strong rosettes and spiny leaves. Agave is best for sunny dry landscapes and large containers.

name: Crown of Thorns
description: A tough succulent shrub with colorful bracts and thorny stems. It flowers best in bright sun and well-drained soil.

name: Brahmi
description: A creeping medicinal herb that likes moisture. Brahmi grows well in wet planters, pond edges, and partially sunny garden beds.

name: Ashwagandha
origin: Indian subcontinent, Middle East and Africa
description: A hardy medicinal shrub grown in dry sunny areas. Ashwagandha prefers well-drained soil and low to moderate watering.

name: Curry Leaf
description: An essential kitchen garden plant with aromatic leaves. Curry Leaf grows well in sunny pots, courtyards, and small home gardens.

name: Lemongrass
description: A clumping aromatic grass useful in herbal teas and kitchen gardens. It prefers sun, regular cutting, and well-drained soil.

name: Mint
description: A fast-growing aromatic herb for chutneys, teas, and garnishes. Mint is best grown in pots with bright shade and regular moisture.

name: Coriander
description: A quick-growing kitchen herb for leaves and seeds. Coriander grows best in mild weather with sun and frequent light harvesting.

name: Betel Leaf
description: A tropical vine grown for aromatic leaves. Betel Leaf prefers shade, humidity, support, and consistently moist soil.

name: Indian Borage
description: A fleshy aromatic herb grown in many home gardens. Indian Borage is easy from cuttings and suits pots or sunny herb beds.

name: Turmeric
description: A rhizome plant valued as a spice and traditional herb. Turmeric grows well in warm, humid, lightly shaded beds or grow bags.

name: Ginger
description: A warm-season rhizome crop for kitchen gardens. Ginger prefers filtered light, rich soil, and steady moisture.

name: Vetiver
description: A deep-rooted aromatic grass used for soil stabilization and fragrant roots. Vetiver is useful on slopes and sunny open ground.

name: Giloy
description: A hardy medicinal climber with heart-shaped leaves. Giloy can be trained over supports in sunny or lightly shaded home gardens.

name: Shatavari
description: A traditional medicinal climber with fine foliage and tuberous roots. It grows well in partial shade with support and drainage.

name: Amla
description: A hardy fruit tree valued for sour fruits used in food and traditional preparations. Amla suits sunny gardens and farm boundaries.

name: Arjuna
description: A large native tree often planted near water bodies and avenues. Arjuna needs open space and develops a strong spreading crown.

name: Peepal
description: A sacred fig tree with heart-shaped leaves and a wide canopy. Peepal is best for large open spaces, temples, and community landscapes.

name: Banyan
description: A majestic native fig with aerial roots and a broad canopy. Banyan requires very large spaces and is unsuitable for small plots.

name: Ashoka Tree
description: A graceful evergreen tree with clusters of orange flowers. True Ashoka suits protected gardens with partial shade and moisture.

name: Indian Mast Tree
description: A tall narrow evergreen tree often used for screening and avenues. It is useful where vertical green structure is needed.

name: Sandalwood
description: A valued native tree known for fragrant heartwood. Sandalwood grows as a hemi-parasite and benefits from nearby host plants.

name: Teak
description: A large deciduous timber tree for farms and spacious landscapes. Teak requires full sun and room for deep rooting and canopy growth.

name: Bamboo
description: A fast-growing clumping bamboo useful for screens, windbreaks, and tropical landscapes. Give it space and manage clump spread.

name: Pongamia
description: A hardy native tree suitable for roadsides, farms, and dry landscapes. Pongamia gives shade and tolerates heat once established.

name: Jamun
description: A large evergreen fruit tree with purple berries. Jamun suits parks, farm edges, and spacious gardens with sunny exposure.

name: Mango
description: A beloved fruit tree for warm sunny regions. Mango needs open space, deep soil, and seasonal pruning for healthy fruiting.

name: Guava
description: A hardy fruit tree that can be grown in gardens or large containers. Guava fruits well in sun with pruning and regular feeding.

name: Coconut
description: A tall tropical palm valued for nuts and landscape character. Coconut needs sun, warmth, and adequate water during dry periods.

name: Banana
description: A fast-growing tropical plant with large leaves and fruiting stems. Banana needs rich soil, sun, and regular watering.

name: Papaya
description: A quick-growing fruit plant for sunny home gardens. Papaya prefers well-drained soil and protection from strong winds.

name: Jackfruit
description: A large evergreen fruit tree suited to warm humid regions. Jackfruit needs open space and deep soil to develop well.

name: Pomegranate
description: A hardy fruit shrub or small tree with orange-red flowers. Pomegranate performs well in sunny, well-drained garden spaces.

name: Drumstick Tree
description: A fast-growing tree grown for pods, leaves, and flowers. Drumstick thrives in sunny, well-drained soil and responds well to pruning.

name: Lemon
description: A productive citrus plant for sunny yards and large pots. Lemon needs feeding, drainage, and sunlight for healthy fruiting.

name: Sapota
description: A hardy evergreen fruit tree with sweet brown fruits. Sapota suits warm sunny gardens and farm plots with moderate watering.

name: Custard Apple
description: A small fruit tree suited to dry sunny areas. Custard Apple produces sweet segmented fruits and needs minimal care once established.

name: Mulberry
description: A fast-growing tree grown for leaves and berries. Mulberry can be pruned as a small garden tree or hedge in sunny spaces.

name: Poinsettia
description: A festive shrub known for bright red, pink, or cream bracts. Poinsettia grows well in sunny beds and large pots.

name: Mussaenda
description: A tropical ornamental shrub with colorful enlarged bracts. Mussaenda is attractive in sunny borders and hospitality landscapes.

name: Duranta
description: A versatile shrub used for hedges, borders, and topiary. Duranta tolerates pruning and gives bright foliage in sunny locations.

name: Thuja
description: A conifer-like evergreen used in formal gardens and entrance planters. Thuja prefers sun and well-drained soil.

name: Silver Oak
description: A tall, fast-growing tree with fern-like foliage and golden flowers. Silver Oak suits avenues, farms, and spacious landscapes.

name: Norfolk Island Pine
description: A symmetrical evergreen often used as an indoor or patio accent. It prefers bright indirect light and evenly moist soil.

name: Lady Palm
description: A refined clumping palm with fan-shaped leaves. Lady Palm is excellent for interiors, verandas, and shaded entry areas.

name: Bottle Palm
description: A decorative palm with a swollen bottle-shaped trunk. Bottle Palm suits sunny lawns, courtyards, and large planters.

name: Royal Palm
description: A tall elegant palm used for grand avenues and large landscapes. Royal Palm needs full sun, space, and regular watering when young.

name: Sago Palm
description: A slow-growing cycad with stiff glossy fronds. Sago Palm is useful in pots, rock gardens, and formal entrance planting.

name: Weeping Fig
origin: South and Southeast Asia and Australia
description: A graceful fig with drooping branches and small leaves. It can be grown as an indoor tree or clipped outdoor screen.

name: Umbrella Plant
description: A compact indoor shrub with umbrella-like leaflets. Schefflera grows well in bright shade and can be pruned to shape.

name: Bamboo Palm
description: A slender indoor palm with cane-like stems. Bamboo Palm is useful for soft screening in offices, lobbies, and shaded patios.

name: English Ivy
description: A trailing or climbing plant for cool shaded spaces. English Ivy works in hanging baskets and indoor shelves with bright indirect light.

name: Asparagus Fern
description: A delicate-looking foliage plant with feathery stems. It suits shaded balconies, hanging baskets, and indoor arrangements.

name: Sweet Basil
description: A fragrant culinary herb for sunny kitchen gardens. Basil responds well to regular pinching and grows easily in containers.

name: Rosemary
description: A woody aromatic herb that prefers sun and excellent drainage. Rosemary is suitable for pots, herb gardens, and dry sunny edges.

name: Lavender
description: A fragrant herb with purple flower spikes. Lavender prefers bright sun, airy conditions, and very well-drained soil.

name: Water Lily
description: A beautiful aquatic plant with floating leaves and colorful flowers. Water Lily is ideal for ponds, tubs, and sunny water gardens.

name: Parijata
description: A small sacred tree with fragrant white-orange flowers that fall in the morning. Parijata suits sunny courtyards, temple gardens, and home landscapes.

name: Bakul
description: An evergreen tree with small fragrant flowers and dense shade. Bakul is useful for avenues, parks, courtyards, and traditional landscapes.
